title: English Around the World
text:
English is spoken in many countries around the world. Many of the people who speak it are not native speakers. Because of this, English is often called a global language. People use it to travel, to work, and to talk to friends from other countries.

English is also important on the internet and in science. Many websites, books, and articles are written in English. For this reason, students often learn English at school. Learning English can help people find better jobs.

questions.text: Why is English often called a global language?
options: Only people in one country speak it
Many of its speakers are not native speakers
It is the oldest language in the world
It is taught only in universities

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, where can you find many texts written in English?
options: On websites, in books, and in articles

questions.text: Why would a student probably want to learn English?
options: Because English is useful for jobs and online information
Because English is hard to read
Because English is used in only one country

questions.text: What can the reader conclude about English from the whole passage?
options: It is spoken only by children
It is used widely in many parts of life
It is less important than other languages
It is used only by native speakers

vocabulary.definition: a native speaker learned the language from birth
knowledge about the world, gained through study and research
to go from one place to another, often far away

paragraph_translations: Англійською мовою розмовляють у багатьох країнах світу. Багато людей, які нею розмовляють, не є носіями мови. Тому англійську часто називають глобальною мовою. Люди використовують її, щоб подорожувати, працювати та спілкуватися з друзями з інших країн.

Англійська також важлива в інтернеті та в науці. Багато вебсайтів, книжок і статей написано англійською. Тому студенти часто вивчають англійську в школі. Вивчення англійської може допомогти людям знайти кращу роботу.
